name: sandbox-create-full
about: No room now on the targets that meet the request: 503 with a Retry-After header (seconds); the refusal says which sandboxes are full and why, naming only targets that could have taken it.

response.error: Shielded sandboxes with an allow list are full right now: runc: not enough free CPU for all sandboxes: needs 1.00, 0.87 free of 2.00
response.fix: try again in about 30 seconds (the Retry-After header), or delete a sandbox you no longer need to free its CPU and memory
